Name: Neighbourhood/Omgivning
Basic relationship:
B_r([a]) = {[x] \in \\R^n: |[x]-[a]|<r}

n=1: open interval (a-r, a+r)
n=2: open disk
n=3: open ball

Name:
Open/closed set
Öppen/Sluten mängd
Basic relationship:
Open interval, closed interval -> Open set, closed set
Öppen interval, sluten intervall -> Öppen mängd, sluten mängd

S is open in \\R^n if every point of S has neighbourhood contained in S (sets defined by strict inequalities < or > e.g. x+y+z>2)

Name: Complement/Komplement, S^c
Basic relationship:
Set of all points in \\R^n that does not belong to S
Complement to open set -> closed set

Name: Boundary point/Randpunkter
Basic relationship:
Every neighbourhood of P contains both points in S and points in S^c
Boundary bdry(S) = set of all boundary points in S
Varje omgivning innehåller inre och yttre punkter

Interior point/Inre punkt: int(S), Inuti mängden (omgivning som ligger innanför mängden
Exterior point/Yttre punkt: ext(S), Utifrån mängden (omgivning som ligger utanför mängden)
Both are open sets

Name: Polära koordinater (\\R^2)
Basic relationship:
[Image]
x = r*cos(\t), y = r*sin(\t)
r = sqrt(x^2+y^2), tan(\t) = y/x

Name: Cylindriska koordinater (\\R^3)
Basic relationship:
[Image]
x = r*cos(\t), y = r*sin(\t), z = z
r = sqrt(x^2+y^2), tan(\t) = y/x, z=z

Name: Sfäriska koordinater (\\R^3)
Basic relationship:
\f: R-line-z, \t -> x-y plane
x = R*sin(\f)*cos(\t), y = R*sin(\f)*sin(\t), z = R*cos(\f)
R = sqrt(x^2+y^2+z^2), tan(\f) = sqrt(x^2+y^2)/z, tan(\t) = y/x

Name: Reelvärda funktioner av flera variabler
Basic relationship:
graf: {(x, y, z): z = f(x, y)}, nivåkurva/höjdkurva: {(x, y): f(x, y) = C} [Image]
Kontinuerlig i (a, b): lim{(x, y) -> (a, b), f(x, y) = f(a, b)}

Name: Partial derivatives/Partiella derivator
Basic relationship:
[Image of z=f(x, y)]
f_('x) = \\df/\\dx = lim{\Dx->0, (f(x+\Dx, y)-f(x, y))/\Dx
f_('y) = \\dy/\\dx = lim{\Dx->0, (f(x, y+\Dy)-f(x, y))/\Dy

Name: Differentierbarhet och linjär approximation
Basic relationship:
Approximation: z = f(a, b) + \\df/\\dx(a, b)*(x-a) + \\df/\\dy(a, b)*(y-b) = f(a, b) + f_('x)(a, b)(x-a) + f_('y)(a, b)*(y-b)
Krav: Partiella derivator och lim{(x, y)->(a, b), (f(x, y) - f(a, b) - \\df/\\dx(a, b)*(x-a) + \\df/\\dy(a, b)*(y-b))/sqrt((x-a)^2 + (y-b)^2)} = 0
(Patologisk funktion f(x, y)={1: (x=0, y=0), 0: (x!=0, y!=0)})

Name: 2nd derivative
Basic relationship:
r\\d^2*f/\\dx^2 = f_('xx)
r\\d^2*f/\\dy^2 = f_('xx)
r\\d^2*f/(\\dx\\dy) = f_('xy)
r\\d^2*f/(\\dy\\dx) = f_('yx)
f_('xy) = f_('yx) if partial derivatives are continous

Name: Gradient och riktningsderivata
Basic relationship: f(x, y) = x^2y, grad f = \nabla f = (\\df/\\dx, \\df/\\dy) = (2xy, x^2)
\nabla f(a, b) är ortogonal mot nivåkurvan till f genom (a, b) och pekar för maxtillväxt av f

(F(x, y, z)=0, G(x, y, z)=0) -> (d/dx(F(x, y(x), z(x)))=0, d/dx(G(x, y(x), z(x)))=0)
\\dF/\\dx + \\dF/\\dy*dy/dx + \\dF/\\dz*dz/dx = 0
\\dG/\\dx + \\dG/\\dy*dy/dx + \\dG/\\dz*dz/dx = 0
-> dy/dx, dz/dx (|[[\\dF/\\dy, \\dF/\\dz], [\\dG/\\dy, \\dG/\\dz]]| != 0)

Name: Optimering/Extremvärden i flera variabler
Basic relationship:
f har max i (a, b) om f(a, b) >= f(x, y)
f kontinuerlig på sluten, begränsad mängd -> garanterar existensen
Max/min kan antas i:
- Kritiska punkter: Alla partiella derivator = 0
- Singulära punkter: Någon av partiella derivator saknas
- Randpunkter

Name: Optimering med bivillkor
Basic relationship:
f(x, y) = (2x+y)^2 som uppfyller g(x, y) = c -> \nabla f och \nabla g paraella, vinkelrät mot nivåkurva (\nabla f = \l*\nabla g)

-> Sök kritiska punkter till (Lagrangefunktionen) L(x, y, \l) = f(x, y) - \l*(g(x, y)-c)
0 = (\\dL)/(\\dx) = (\\df)/(\\dx) - \l*(\\dg)/(\\dx))
0 = (\\dL)/(\\dy) = (\\df)/(\\dy) - \l*(\\dg)/(\\dy))
0 = (\\dL)/(\\d\l) = g(x, y)

Name: Konservativ vektorfält
Basic relationship:
[F](x, y, z) = \nabla f(x, y, z), [F] med potential f
[F] = (P, Q, R) = ((\\df)/(//dx), (\\df)/(//dy), (\\df)/(//dz))
(\\dP)/(\\dy) = (\\dQ)/(\\dx), (\\dQ)/(\\dz) = (\\dR)/(\\dy), (\\dP)/(\\dz) = (\\dR)/(\\dx)

Blandade andraderivatorna lika:
\\f_('xy) = \\f_('yx) -> (\\dP)/(\\dy) = (\\dQ)/(\\dx)

Fältlinjer, potential, ekvipotentiallinjer

Name: Kurvintegraler av vektorfält
Basic relationship:
[F] = (P, Q), [r](t) = (x(t), y(t))
int2{\g, [F].[dr]} = int2{\g, Pdx+Qdy} = int{a, b, (P(x(t), y(t))x'(t) + Q(x(t), y(t))y'(t))dt}

Konservativ vektorfält, [F]=(y^2, 2xy) -> f=xy^2, [r](t) = (t, t^2) r(0) -> r(1)
int2{\g, [F].[dr]} = f(1, 1^2) - f(0, 0^2)
